# Maggie Blank — Lowcountry Mortgage Advisor

> Mortgage guidance from Maggie Blank of Synovus Bank for physicians, first-time buyers, self-employed borrowers, and other homebuyers in Bluffton, Hilton Head Island, Beaufort, Okatie, and the South Carolina Lowcountry. NMLS #504377.

This site provides general educational information about mortgage programs, construction and refinance options, relocation, and Lowcountry housing considerations. Loan availability and terms are subject to underwriting, credit, property approval, and applicable lender requirements.

## Primary Pages

- [Home](https://www.lowcountrymortgageadvisor.com/): Overview of Maggie Blank's mortgage advisory services and Lowcountry expertise.
- [About Maggie](https://www.lowcountrymortgageadvisor.com/about): Professional background and approach.
- [Concierge Approach](https://www.lowcountrymortgageadvisor.com/concierge): The site's personalized mortgage process.
- [Loan Solutions](https://www.lowcountrymortgageadvisor.com/loan-solutions): Overview of available financing paths.
- [Physician Loans](https://www.lowcountrymortgageadvisor.com/physician-loans): Mortgage options designed for physicians.
- [First-Time Buyers](https://www.lowcountrymortgageadvisor.com/first-time-buyers): Programs and guidance for first-time homebuyers.
- [Self-Employed Borrowers](https://www.lowcountrymortgageadvisor.com/self-employed): Documentation and financing guidance for self-employed borrowers.
- [Conventional Loans](https://www.lowcountrymortgageadvisor.com/conventional): Conventional mortgage information.
- [Construction Loans](https://www.lowcountrymortgageadvisor.com/construction): Construction-to-permanent financing information.
- [Private Wealth Mortgages](https://www.lowcountrymortgageadvisor.com/private-wealth): Jumbo and portfolio lending information.
- [Refinancing](https://www.lowcountrymortgageadvisor.com/refinance): Refinance strategies and considerations.
- [Resources](https://www.lowcountrymortgageadvisor.com/resources): Mortgage tools and educational resources.
- [Apply](https://www.lowcountrymortgageadvisor.com/apply): How to begin the mortgage process.
- [Contact](https://www.lowcountrymortgageadvisor.com/contact): Contact information and consultation request.
